reason: Both proposals target the same intervention and mechanism, but Candidate A is more specific and testable: it defines a clear compositional series (e.g., Nb1.1ZrTiHfMo0.9), explicitly ties the mechanism to reduced electronegativity difference and dislocation mobility, and sets a falsification rule with a precise strength-loss threshold (≈10%).
